comment: No source is published, so nothing here was read from code. The mode and menu wording is the maker's own: the delay modes are named Dual, Ping-pong, Single with send/return and Cascade with send/return, the time modulation switch is named Resampling and Crossfading where the hardware panel and manual say tape and fade, and the context menu carries Loop button behavior (Toggling or Momentary) and Sync prescaler. Where the hardware has a settings editor entered by holding the delay mode button, this plugin puts those two settings on the context menu instead, and the 2.0.0 changelog records that a delay mode selector was taken off that menu. The delay range of 5ms to 2.73 seconds, the 125% feedback maximum with its snap to 100%, the equal-power dry/wet curve and the normalling of the time CV inputs are all from the Chronoblob2 hardware manual version 1.3, and could not be checked against the plugin. The hardware manual's 0.7V threshold on the loop gate and its firmware update procedure are left out, being electrical and hardware-only. The panel carries almost no lettering: SYNC is the only word on it, and every other control is marked with an icon. The status lamp behaviour is from the Chronoblob2 hardware manual version 1.3, read as a PDF on this pass; the manual's overload threshold of 20 volts peak to peak is left out, being a hardware figure that could not be checked against the plugin.
